svg.text: QF_LRA division: the 656 instances not solved by every solver under 10s
656 instances, 300s per instance. Only solved instances contribute a point; timeouts do not.
Excludes 1097 further instances every solver finished in under 10s, so every count here is of the remaining 656. Gaps between curves are unaffected.
